subject: Senior Software Engineer — 7+ Yrs, Java, AWS & Generative AI Expertise
body:
Dear [Hiring Manager's Name],

I hope this message finds you well. My name is Virender Kumar, and I am writing to express my keen interest in the Senior Software Engineer position at ServiceNow. With over 7 years of experience in designing and developing cloud-native applications using Java, AWS, and modern frontend frameworks such as React and Next.js, I am confident in my ability to contribute effectively to your team.

In my current role as a Senior Full Stack AI Developer at Impressico Business Solutions, I successfully led the migration of Strapi CMS from v4 to v5, resulting in a 30% improvement in backend response times. My efforts in optimizing CI/CD pipelines reduced deployment failures by 50%, significantly enhancing release efficiency. I prioritize writing clean, maintainable code and enforce best practices through thorough code reviews and unit testing, aligning perfectly with the responsibilities outlined in the job description.

Moreover, my extensive experience in building scalable applications and a proven track record of delivering significant performance improvements and reducing production defects position me as an ideal candidate to help ServiceNow achieve its innovative objectives while ensuring high code quality.

I would be thrilled to discuss how my skills and experiences align with the goals of your team. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to speak with you.

Best regards,

Virender Kumar  
Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India
